summary: Backend pytest suite (15/15 passed) covers all requested endpoints: health, master login + 401 wrong creds, /auth/me, user CRUD + generated_password, list users excludes master and _id, reset-password rotation + login with new pw, master self-protection (reset 403 and delete 403), slot create/list (public, no _id), /slots/mine for servizio_civile, public booking creation that decrements capacity and returns 400 when full, admin booking listing + 401 unauthenticated, booking deletion restores booked_count. Frontend (Expo web @ mobile viewport 390x844) loads Home (hero, servizi, quick links, about, bottom tabs), Account tab shows Area Riservata login form, master login (from MASTER_USERNAME/MASTER_PASSWORD env) succeeds and dashboard renders 'Ciao, Master Admin', 'Ruolo: MASTER', date strip, Slot (0), Prenotazioni (0), and FAB (+). Prenota tab step 1 (Tipo di Mezzo: Ambulanza/Furgone) renders with 1/3 indicator and Continua button. No page errors. Minor non-fatal warnings only.

issues: Console warning: "shadow*" style props deprecated → use boxShadow
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated → use style.pointerEvents
Console warning: Animated useNativeDriver not supported on web (JS fallback) — harmless on web build

react_native_issues.issue: Warning: [Layout children]: No route named 'login' exists in nested children: [index, (tabs), admin/slot-new, admin/users]. A <Stack.Screen name="login"/> is declared somewhere but the route file is missing (or vice-versa). Non-fatal, but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated shadow* props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence React Native Web warnings.
Optional: remove the stray 'login' Stack.Screen reference (or add the matching route) in the root _layout.tsx to eliminate the expo-router warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~570-line file — acceptable for current scope but consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/users.py, routers/slots.py, routers/bookings.py if growth continues.
All Mongo reads correctly project out _id.
Master credentials are re-seeded on every startup (idempotent) — good.
Bookings POST has no rate-limit / captcha — public endpoint could be abused; not in scope but worth noting.
SMTP credentials are stored in plaintext in backend/.env (expected for this environment).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on smoke flows tested (home, account login, master dashboard, prenota step 1)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_sc_* user + TEST slot + a booking, all cleaned up via fixtures. Master account is auto-seeded by backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE URL: https://servizio-civile-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Master creds: read from MASTER_USERNAME / MASTER_PASSWORD in backend/.env (never hardcoded). Re-run pytest with `EXPO_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_provvidenza_api.py -v`. For frontend, use mobile viewport 390x844 and navigate via tab bar text labels (Home, Prenota, Servizio Civile, Volontari, Account). Booking step 2/3 and the admin slot-creation FAB modal + user-creation modal were NOT exercised end-to-end (only confirmed they open). Recommend deeper E2E for booking create through UI and admin user creation modal in a future iteration.
